assignment.title: Four-skill practice, transfer and delayed return
assignment.instructions:
LISTEN: answer “What should the customer do if the price is not acceptable?” from the recording before reading the script. Save the listening result separately.

READ: answer the gist and detail questions, and mark the exact phrase that proves each answer. Save the reading result separately.

SPEAK: Call a clinic or repair shop to change a booking and confirm the new arrangement. Record an independent first attempt, then improve one feature.

WRITE: Write a follow-up message confirming what was agreed on the phone. Draft without the model, then revise for reader, purpose, essential detail and next action.

TRANSFER: The offered time is impossible; reject it politely and propose two alternatives.

BETWEEN LESSON · Optional, 5 minutes: Use the confirmation question again in the service clinic.
assignment.model:
SPEAKING MODEL: Hej, jag ringer angående min bokning på torsdag klockan 14.20. Jag har fått förhinder. Skulle ni kunna flytta tiden till fredag? Har jag förstått rätt att den nya tiden är klockan tre?

WRITING MODEL: Hej! Tack för samtalet. Som vi kom överens om har min tid flyttats från torsdag klockan 14.20 till fredag klockan 15.00. Meddela gärna om jag har uppfattat något fel. Vänliga hälsningar, Alex

takeaways: Use: Jag ringer angående min bokning.
Register: Kan ni flytta min tid? → Skulle ni kunna flytta min tid?
A successful service call ends with a shared, explicit understanding.
